Description: Time the Wazuh Engine received the event, in UTC. The time in the original log is in `event.start`.

Example: Oct 13 13:00:57 wazuh-aio sshd[9538]: pam_unix(sshd:session): session opened for user vagrant(uid=1000) by (uid=0)
